candidates.change_summary: Return true unconditionally instead of checking interfaceId.
Return false unconditionally instead of checking interfaceId.
Remove the super call so only IAccessControl interface is checked.
Check against a wrong interface (IERC165) so that IAccessControl is never reported as supported.
Negate the condition so that supported interfaces become unsupported and vice versa.
Invert the return value by returning the negation of the membership check.
Return false unconditionally, ignoring the stored role membership.
Return true unconditionally, ignoring the stored role membership.
Always return bytes32(0) instead of the actual admin role.
Return the input role itself instead of the stored admin role.
Remove the requirement that the caller renounces only for themselves, allowing anyone to renounce any role for any account.
